title: Mughal-Karrani conflict intensifies in Bengal
detail: Campaigns between Akbar's forces and Daud Khan Karrani escalated into a decisive contest over Bengal's political control.

title: Battle of Rajmahal ends in Mughal victory
detail: Daud Khan Karrani was defeated at Rajmahal, marking the military collapse of the last major Afghan-led sultanate resistance in Bengal.

title: Bengal moves into the Mughal provincial order
detail: After Rajmahal, Bengal's governance increasingly followed Mughal subah administration, creating new fiscal and political dynamics in the region.
